PC Shut off and instantly fails after starting
I've had this PC for a bit over 4 years now, and it's generally worked exceptionally well in all that time. 

Recently however, I slammed my fist down on my desk, which my PC sits on top of. Immediately, it shut off. I went to turn it back on and it wouldn't.
 
I took off the side panels and looked inside, wiggled the connections, made sure everything was plugged in, etc., but when I tried to turn it on again, it did what I can only describe as "a flicker". the fans would start to spin up before immediately stopping, the lights didn't even come on.

I know there's power, as my Ethernet port light is flashing, but nothing I've done has worked in fixing it. any advice or ideas would be greatly appreciated.
